name: Claude Monet
findings: Within his own canvases, russian green turns up as a small accent in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 2.4x the archive's rate (from 2595 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, rose taupe turns up as the shadow in 78% of the paintings that hold it, 2.9x the archive's rate (from 2595 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 2595 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 2595 paintings here).
Pairs bluish grey-green with greyish teal more than chance would predict (3 of 2595 paintings here).
Pairs reed yellow with sand more than chance would predict (3 of 2595 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (pale lilac grey, french grey, light grey) covers 65% of his paintings here.
Keeps 2 distinct palette families here, from pale lilac grey, french grey to dark olive brown, beige grey.
